'''2000 Seattle Grand Slam''' was a Decipher-era constructed event. Published lists from this event are the 60s Decipher posted on Deck Designs.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Dates:''' February 2000
* '''Site:''' Wizards of the Coast Game Center, Seattle, Washington<ref name="tr-d196" />

== Grand Slam 2000 series ==

The Seattle event was one of 31 Grand Slam 2000 weekends, each with Star Wars CCG, Star Trek CCG and Young Jedi constructed events.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Seattle Grand Slam Charles Hickey Guess What Han is still in San Fran]] ([[Charles Hickey]], [[Light]]; 4–0) — "this deck has gone 4-0 at the Seattle Grand Slam"
* [[2000 Seattle Grand Slam Joe Olson No Sleep (Choke em) v 2 3]] ([[Joe Olson]], [[Light]]) — "An updated version of the deck I played @ the Seattle G. Slam"; no result given

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub's Format box and the List give February 2000 (the month Decipher posted the winning lists on Deck Designs), but Douglas Harvilla's and Charles Hickey's reports both date the event Saturday 22 January 2000; the hub's own Grand Slam 2000 table already lists it under January 2000.<ref name="tr-d196" />
* The hub's Format box and the List give February 2000 (the month Decipher posted the winning lists on Deck Designs), but Douglas Harvilla's and Charles Hickey's reports both date the event Saturday 22 January 2000; the hub's own Grand Slam 2000 table already lists it under January 2000.<ref name="tr-d202" />
